explanation: The Wronskian is W=27, and the minor for u₂ is W₂=3 cos(3x). Thus u₂'=−gW₂/W=−(−9 tan(3x))(3 cos(3x))/27=sin(3x). Integrating gives u₂=−cos(3x)/3, with the constant absorbed into B. Variation of parameters for scalar ordinary differential equations is absent from the supplied course topics, so this is prerequisite.
